doc.title: Pantry thresholds: oats and rice at half

footing_cases.author: claude-opus-5-5
footing_cases.when: The memo's own editorial prose, composed by Claude per the envelope's drafted_by, on a document the envelope attributes to author Tina TeamMember.

segments.exact: The one-third restock threshold from the 1 October call stays for every shelf except oats and rice, which now restock at half full. Those two run out fastest, and a third full is less than a day of stock on a Friday.

circumstance.context: Pantry restock thresholds note; updates the 1 October call's one-third threshold for oats and rice

segments.note: One move: states the threshold decision with its rationale; kept as a single segment per the one-act rule.
